question: Which two organisations have collaborated to develop a Close Quarter Battle (CQB) Carbine for the Indian Armed Forces?
solution:
The correct answer is __**DRDO and Bharat Forge**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)**, through its **Pune**-based laboratory, the **Armament Research and Development Establishment (ARDE)**, has successfully designed and developed a **5.56x45mm Close Quarter Battle (CQB) Carbine**.
 
• For the manufacturing and production phase, **DRDO** collaborated with **Bharat Forge Limited**, a prominent private sector defense manufacturer under the **Kalyani Group**.
 
• This indigenous **CQB Carbine** was developed to fulfill the **Indian Army's** requirement for a modern, high-performance weapon to replace the aging **9mm Sterling 1A1 submachine guns**.
